question: Does the literal v17 U8/H3/top-32 physical program transfer without refit to two unseen v18 temporal constructions while remaining selective on answer-preserving and canonical controls?

searched: temporal/is-was v15-v17 module, Shapley, A11-head, and restricted-weight tensor records
all v4-v18 construction authorities and capability manifests
shared-subspace, weight-atlas, control-family, and transfer records
AGENT_BOARD, BILIN18_CONNECTION, BENCHMARK_BACKLOG, and the canonical temporal dossier
prior_art.nearest_result: V17 identified a shared U8 with A11/M11 HOLDOUT causal recovery .993/.923, H3 carrying about 90% of A11 loss, and a weight-defined top-32 M11 factor program recovering .809 on HOLDOUT. All were selected or fit on v17 A2; none has been run on v18.
prior_art.novelty: V18 contains two unseen aligned target constructions and sixteen unused professions. Its independently executed capability-only result qualified all 16 rows in each A panel before any v18 causal outcome. This is the first immutable construction transfer of the joint U8/H3/top-32 physical program with P/C selectivity controls.

frozen_design.population: All capability-qualified v18 A1 and A2 rows (16 each), plus all 16 P and all 16 C control rows, evaluated as four separate panels.
frozen_design.program: Restore the exact float32 1152x8 residual-stream U basis and its byte hash from the v17 result; use only H3 at A11; use exactly the first 32 stored v17 M11 factor indices in their stored order. No v18 fit, SVD, optimization, selection, reordering, threshold change, or dose calibration. Prospective instrument correction at 2026-09-08T16:30Z: the initial prose and runner guard incorrectly called U 4608x8, conflating residual width 1152 with M11 hidden width 4608. The failed run stopped at this shape guard before intervention outcomes; only the literal dimension label/guard changes.
frozen_design.source: Patch the same physical L7H7 and L9H4 post-cue writer outputs used in v17. For each panel capture native, donor, writer-present, and reader-absent states. Prospective instrument correction at 2026-09-08T16:34Z: the v17 helper assumes equal base/donor token lengths, but canonical C intentionally has unequal prefixes. The failed run reached this guard after target/P computations but emitted no result or values, and no intermediate causal values were inspected. Map each base position in the exact longest common suffix to its corresponding donor suffix position; require identical suffix token IDs. This is identical to the old same-index mapping on A1/A2/P and changes only how the registered C control is made live.

target_measurements.reachability: Fraction of full A11/M11 reader-delta energy lying in frozen U8.
target_measurements.U8_causality: Signed recovery and cosine of the frozen-U8 reader effect relative to full physical reader loss, separately on A1 and A2.
target_measurements.H3: Signed recovery, cosine, and direction agreement of H3 removal relative to all-nine-head A11 removal.
target_measurements.top32: Signed recovery and cosine of the exact frozen top-32 M11 output effect relative to the full frozen-U8 M11 effect.

frozen_design.controls: For P and C separately, compare RMS U8, H3, and top-32 score movement with the corresponding pooled A1+A2 target-effect RMS. Each normalized control ratio must be at most .25; report P/C native correctness but do not condition on it.

predictions.pred_a_authority_frozen_program_capture_: All hashes/populations/calls pass, writer replay is within 1e-5, frozen basis restores bit-exactly, every value is finite, and execution costs exactly 44 forwards/704 sequences/1408 scored positions with no fitting.
predictions.pred_b_frozen_U8_reaches_and_causally_ex: For A1 and A2 separately, A11 and M11 frozen-U8 energy is at least .80 and causal signed recovery/cosine is at least .80/.95.
predictions.pred_c_frozen_H3_remains_the_majority_A1: For A1 and A2, H3 removal recovers at least .50 of all-head A11 removal, cosine is at least .95, and direction agreement is at least .875.
predictions.pred_d_frozen_top32_M11_factor_program_t: For A1 and A2, the stored top-32 factors recover at least .70 of the frozen-U8 M11 effect with cosine at least .95.
predictions.pred_e_frozen_program_is_selective_on_an: Every registered U8/H3/top-32 normalized RMS movement ratio is at most .25 on P and separately on C.

nulls.activation_specific: Failure of B with valid A means the v17 U8 described a construction-specific occupied subspace rather than a stable reader variable.
nulls.native_boundary_specific: B passes but C fails: cross-module U8 transfers, but H3 is not the stable within-A11 semantic endpoint.
nulls.factor_specific: B/C pass but D fails: the shared subspace transfers while the v17 weight-defined M11 hierarchy is activation-regime specific.
nulls.nonselective: B-D pass but E fails: the program transfers the target but also carries generic temporal/lexical or unrelated control movement and is not selectively identified.

decision: Promote to construction-general shared physical circuit only if A-E all pass. Preserve every partial terminal and do not refit v18 after a miss.
